title: Guides
description: Follow the project from its first screen change to original firmware, audio and the work still on the bench.
metadataDescription: The OpenSP project journal: display experiments, original firmware, controls, USB updates, audio and research in progress.
note: Each chapter separates device observations, offline checks and open questions. The downloadable exercises use invented data and run without an SP. Research chapters describe work in progress, not released features.
